findings.desc: codex host-2: sanitizeNestedDetails (codex-cli.ts:122-129) copies EVERY own key of prompt_tokens_details, not only the adapter-read cached_tokens. A real payload prompt_tokens_details:{cached_tokens:1, transcript:"secret"} surfaces the nested non-token key transcript in reportedUsage, violating the story's token-only projection contract. This is an own-key leak (NOT prototype pollution) so it triggers on a plain provider response. The OpenAI adapter reads ONLY prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens (adapters/openai.ts:84), so the nested projection must whitelist exactly cached_tokens.
findings.resolvedReason: sanitizeNestedDetails now whitelists only the adapter-read cached_tokens (CODEX_NESTED_DETAIL_KEYS) into a null-proto object; nested non-token keys (e.g. transcript) are dropped. Fixed in 024bb0e30; smoke asserts only own cached_tokens===5, length 1, null-proto, transcript absent, cacheRead still resolves.

findings.desc: codex host-2: the usage-shape predicates isCodexUsageObject (codex-cli.ts:99) and isGeminiUsageObject (gemini-cli.ts:~102) still use prototype-chain `in` reads. With Object.prototype.prompt_tokens (or promptTokenCount) polluted, an empty own {usage:{}} matches as a valid usage object, so extractCodexUsage/extractGeminiUsage select it, project an empty null-proto object, and STOP before a later real usage line. Repro (codex-verified): pollute Object.prototype.prompt_tokens, stdout "{usage:{}}\n{usage:{prompt_tokens:10,completion_tokens:2}}" returns keys [] instead of the real counts. This defeats the extractCodexUsage ownProp guard at codex-cli.ts:189. Fix: the predicates must use own-property checks (ownProp) to stay consistent with the in-scope extractor hardening.
findings.resolvedReason: isCodexUsageObject/isGeminiUsageObject now use ownProp own-property guards instead of prototype-chain in, so a polluted Object.prototype token key cannot make an empty first usage object suppress a later real one. Fixed in 024bb0e30; smoke asserts the real later counts (10/2) are selected under pollution for codex+gemini.

findings.desc: codex host-2: the smoke does not exercise (a) a nested non-token key under prompt_tokens_details being dropped from the projected reportedUsage (the bug above), nor (b) the false-positive `in`-predicate case where a polluted Object.prototype token key makes an empty first usage object suppress a later real usage line. Add both cases for codex and (for the predicate case) gemini.
findings.resolvedReason: Smoke extended (+3 checks, now 53) covering the nested non-token-key drop and the polluted-prototype empty-first-usage suppression for codex and gemini. Fixed in 024bb0e30.
